CRISIS ZONE To extend the life of the Gun Motor, it has become neccesary to reduce the voltage to the motor from 24v DC (as shown on the schematic), to 22v DC. This has been accomplished by the addition of 1 or 2 bridge rectifiers placed in the circuit between the 24v DC 3A Fuse and the Gun PCB.
